# 周末不无聊 No Boring Weekends

> 北美华人周末活动指南：15 个城市的亲子和大人周末活动，华人与亚裔社区活动优先，中英双语，每周更新（本期 11/13–11/15，更新于 2026-11-13）。
> Weekend events for families and grown-ups in 15 North American cities (festivals, shows, family outings, Chinese/Asian community events), bilingual, updated weekly.

每个城市有固定网址的「本周末」页面，内容每周替换；每个城市还有可订阅的日历（.ics）。活动信息以主办方官网为准。
Each city has a fixed weekend page that is replaced weekly, plus a subscribable .ics calendar. Check organizers' sites before going.

## 城市页（中文）
- [纽约本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/nyc/): 12 个活动，MOCA 闽南语/客家话/潮州话方言角、亚洲协会:韩国单色画讲座、亚洲协会 70 周年夜场:灯光节
- [新泽西本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/nj/): 10 个活动，South Plainfield 排灯节庆祝、Raritan 秋日餐车音乐节、Terhune 果园派品尝周末(周六/日)
- [洛杉矶本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/la/): 10 个活动，华埠图书馆:洛杉矶唐人街纪录片放映、格里菲斯天文台(周五开到晚 10 点)、自然历史博物馆 NightTales
- [旧金山湾区本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/sf/): 11 个活动，华裔历史博物馆退伍军人节活动(圣何塞)、亚洲艺术博物馆假日手作市集+竹艺讲座、日本茶园免费一小时(周一/三/五)
- [西雅图本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/sea/): 11 个活动，西雅图苗族新年、鹊桥艺术舞蹈节(O-Jak Bridge)、BOYNEXTDOOR 演唱会
- [波士顿本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/bos/): 7 个活动，波士顿 Bhangra 舞蹈大赛、Victoria Monét 演唱会、Snowport 海港假日市集
- [芝加哥本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/chi/): 10 个活动，华人互助会 × Haibayo 中秋晚会、亚裔艺术家沙龙 Permission to Fail、日裔服务会 Holiday Delight & 儿童节
- [休斯顿本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/hou/): 12 个活动，吉卜力致敬艺术展(一晚限定)、亚洲协会德州中心建筑导览、Discovery Green 排灯节
- [达拉斯本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/dal/): 9 个活动，《KPop 猎魔女团》沉浸式体验、The Colony 美国英雄节、Little Elm 草坪电影《玩具总动员 5》
- [华盛顿 DC本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/dc/): 9 个活动，国立亚洲艺术博物馆家庭工作坊、DowntownDC 假日市集(开幕)、Renwick 美术馆新展(免费)
- [橙县 / 尔湾本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/oc/): 7 个活动，迪士尼乐园圣诞季开幕、尔湾 Spectrum 溜冰场、Heritage 博物馆原住民 Pow Wow
- [圣地亚哥本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/sd/): 6 个活动，圣地亚哥亚洲电影节(收官)、巴尔博亚公园横滨节、Poway 火车歌谣节
- [亚特兰大本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/atl/): 9 个活动，佐治亚水族馆 WinterTide(开幕)、木偶艺术中心《红鼻子驯鹿鲁道夫》、Duluth 母婴展 Babypalooza
- [多伦多本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/tor/): 8 个活动，菲律宾圣诞村 Paskuhan Village、奥克维尔圣诞老人游行、酿酒厂区冬季村
- [温哥华本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/van/): 10 个活动，华裔加拿大人博物馆《Momentum》体育展、温哥华亚洲电影节(收官周末)、日裔国家博物馆手作市集(周六/日)

## City pages (English)
- [New York weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/nyc/): 12 events, e.g. New York Transit Museum Holiday Train Show; Grand Central Holiday Fair; MoMA PS1 Free Saturday
- [New Jersey weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/nj/): 10 events, e.g. Raritan Borough Fall Food Truck & Music Fest; Diwali Celebration in South Plainfield; Pie Tasting Weekend at Terhune Orchards
- [Los Angeles weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/la/): 10 events, e.g. Griffith Observatory; NightTales at the Natural History Museum; Documentary Screening on L.A. Chinatown
- [SF Bay Area weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/sf/): 11 events, e.g. Saturday Science at the Randall Museum; Veterans Day Program at the Chinese American Historical Museum; Holiday Artisan Market & Bamboo Artist Talk at the Asian Art Museum
- [Seattle weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/sea/): 11 events, e.g. Garth Brooks; Seattle International Auto Show; Gobble Up Seattle
- [Boston weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/bos/): 7 events, e.g. Victoria Monét; Boston Bhangra Competition; Snowport Holiday Market
- [Chicago weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/chi/): 10 events, e.g. Friday the 13th Family Night at Southside STEM Station; Lightscape at the Chicago Botanic Garden; Permission to Fail: Asian American Artists Salon
- [Houston weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/hou/): 12 events, e.g. Sunset Cinema: WALL-E; Studio Ghibli Tribute Art Show; Houston Ballet Nutcracker Market
- [Dallas weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/dal/): 9 events, e.g. American Heroes Festival; Toy Story 5 on the Lawn; KPop Demon Hunters: The Immersive Experience
- [Washington DC weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/dc/): 9 events, e.g. DowntownDC Holiday Market; Renwick Gallery Reinstallation; Art Guardians: Painting Rescue at the National Museum of Asian Art
- [Orange County weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/oc/): 7 events, e.g. Holidays at the Disneyland Resort; Ice Skating at Irvine Spectrum Center; Free Powwow at the Heritage Museum of Orange County
- [San Diego weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/sd/): 6 events, e.g. San Diego Asian Film Festival; Train Song Festival; Yokohama Festival in Balboa Park
- [Atlanta weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/atl/): 9 events, e.g. WinterTide at Georgia Aquarium; Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer at the Center for Puppetry Arts; Atlanta Babypalooza Baby Expo
- [Toronto weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/tor/): 8 events, e.g. Oakville Santa Claus Parade; Kain Tayo sa Paskuhan Village; Distillery Winter Village
- [Vancouver weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/van/): 10 events, e.g. Vancouver Asian Film Festival; Momentum: Power and Identity in Sports, Chinese Canadian Museum; Raffi in Concert
